name: compdb-lto-msvc
description: Issue #23, fix plan F1: a compile_commands.json of a project built with LTO for the MSVC ABI (clang++ --target=x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -flto -c, written by the runner's `prepare compdb-lto-msvc`). Every command the server gives clangd must carry -c: without it clangd's module dependency scan fails on the driver's `LTO requires -fuse-ld=lld`, no module is built, and the importer reports its import as not found and hovers across it answer nothing. The driver raises that for the windows-msvc target on any host, so this runs on Linux.
